playstyle: Explosive Mishima. Threaten the Wind God Fist (EWGF in Heat or with perfect input), Demon's Paw and the hellsweep from a crouch dash, and fly into Mourning Crow (MCR) for aerial pressure. Big reward, big risk: Wavu notes his hellsweep is his only truly threatening low.

stances.name: Mourning Crow
stances.entry: df+2 or ws3 with F on hit, and other transitions
stances.note: Flight stance: MCR.2,2 is a Heat Engager, MCR.3 instantly tornadoes (+70a on hit).

keyMoves: i11 special mid crouch jab, -4 on block.
Wind God Fist: i11 high launcher, -10 on block. In Heat it becomes the EWGF (Wavu).
His signature launcher: fast, long and huge.
As a punisher, a whiff punish and in neutral from a crouch dash.
Practise the crouch dash motion until it is automatic.
Double Lift Kicks: i15 launcher, -15 on block.
After lows that are -14 or worse.
Use when ws2 is too slow.
Demon's Paw: i15 mid, -8 on block, Heat Engager.
A safe, long mid that starts Heat.
Demon Steel Pedal: i17 mid, launches on counter hit (+30a), -8 on block.
Aratama Strike: i20 mid, +3c on block, spikes.
A plus mid that keeps the turn.
Hellsweep: i16 low from a crouch dash, -23c on block.
Once the opponent respects the Wind God Fist.
The low half of his Mishima mix-up.
Broken Plate: i18 low, -12 on block.
Judgment: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Instant tornado BnB: 3,1 b,f+2,1,2
combos.situation: After an instant tornado such as ws2.
mistakes: Pressing 3,1 too late: the opponent is already spinning low.
Mixing up b,f+2 with f+2: it is back, then forward.
